_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

Fixes #27479
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`ui/scripts/` 下两处文字(一条测试注释、Dependabot 合并门里一条可选检查的说明)不再点名已退役的 `required-set-patrol.yml` / `board-snapshot.yml`,改指根 `fleet-patrols.yml` 里的同名 job。
- 为什么改:这两个巡检 workflow 已并入 `fleet-patrols.yml`,旧文件名会把读者引向不存在的文件。
- 风险与回滚:只改注释与一条说明字符串,零行为变化(该字符串只要求长度 > 40,无人打印或解析);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` 的 `Snapshot the board to the archive branch` 条目;其次 `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts` 的 retired-pins 注释。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -E 'required-set-patrol\.yml|platform-checklist-watchdog\.yml|release-coverage-patrol\.yml|board-snapshot\.yml' -- ui/`,预期零输出(退出码 1)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts`: the comment over the retired workflow pins now names the `required-set-patrol` job of the root `fleet-patrols.yml` instead of the retired root `required-set-patrol.yml`. Comment only.
- `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`: the `OPTIONAL_CONTEXTS` reason for `Snapshot the board to the archive branch` now names the `board-snapshot` job of the root `fleet-patrols.yml`. Its paths-filter clause is restated to match that workflow (the workflow file plus the root scripts its jobs run, none under `ui/`), because "the workflow file itself" stopped being the whole filter when four patrols became one file. The key and the bucket are unchanged.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts scripts/__tests__/dependabot-merge-gate.test.ts`: 2 files, 47 tests passed (run under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (the derived family) on head `814431ed`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4902 tests passed, 2 skipped (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- No test asserts the reason text beyond `states a reason for every context it declines to gate on` (length over 40), and the script reads only the keys of `OPTIONAL_CONTEXTS`, so no pin moves with the string.

## Acceptance notes

- Card reading: `git grep -n -E 'required-set-patrol\.yml|platform-checklist-watchdog\.yml|release-coverage-patrol\.yml|board-snapshot\.yml' -- ui/` reads 0 lines on this branch (exit 1); it read 2 on `origin/main` at the branch point.
- Verified on `origin/main` before the edit: `.github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml` declares jobs `required-set-patrol` and `board-snapshot`, and its header table maps each to the retired file.
- No changeset: `ui/scripts` belongs to the private `object-ui-monorepo` root and publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- Not touched: the comment's other references (`required-check-set-patrol.yml` is objectui's own retired file, correctly named as such).

## Verification

Local gate subset and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the report comment on #27479; every CI family is read from this PR's check-runs.
